title: Pizza Delivery Game Prototype
author: Sea-River4818
selftext:
I had an idea one evening of making a pizza delivery game, so heres a little prototype I have created using claude code, mostly Opus 4.6, I tried Fable 5 when it was still available and a little of Opus 4.8 but Opus 4.6 is more than capable writing the scripts and doing the building whilst I only adjust some values and move things around. I'm still learning to use godot and this was the first time I ever exported a game and chose web(not sure why but its only for demonstration purposes only). 

I will continue working on this and hopefully will have an actual demo of the game soon...

Let me know what you think of this idea

comments.author: rekansebangku
comments.body: It definitely needs some work on the animations, at least so it doesn't feel like the character is sliding around. Anyway, keep it up!

replies.author: Sea-River4818
replies.body: Yeah the animations are only what Fable was able to do, I need to learn to do animations myself and hopefully make it better for the next stage of this game 😁
